facts.fact: 第五层一具消瘦尸体身上被找到一张手写纸条：写信人想结束生命，却因仍盼有人来救而做不到
facts.anchor: Note found on an emaciated corpse in the Fifth Layer

facts.fact: Petra 扒开 nylon 包裹，露出一具与睡袋粘连的腐尸；这睡袋与她曾在 Mr. Stone 店里买的同款
facts.anchor: revealing a decomposing corpse half fused to the fabric

facts.fact: Flint 从死者腿下抽出的背包里倒出 two combat knives、a drained water purifier 和 three maps
facts.anchor: Out tumble two combat knives, a drained water purifier, three maps

facts.fact: Flint 否认曾偷 Jade 的东西，瞪着 Petra 说 Jade 在撒谎；Jade 坚称那是多年前的事
facts.anchor: absurd⁠—I wouldn’t do that.” He locks eyes with me

facts.fact: Flint 决定在岛上过夜，把闹钟设成 eight hours；Jade 想再赶一段路被他否掉
facts.anchor: set an alarm for eight hours.” Flint pulls a small clock from his bag

facts.fact: Jade 断言那 fiend 就是 Petra 的父亲，Flint 的父亲偷走 relic 后把 Petra 父亲丢下等死
facts.anchor: And his dad stole the relic from yours and left him for dead

facts.fact: Flint 盯着海藻床时自行拔掉耳塞，违反他自己给 Petra 和 Jade 定的规矩
facts.anchor: Flint grabs his earplugs and pulls them out

facts.fact: 海底之物拽住黄线，Petra 双手死攥不放，黄线最终被从她手里整个扯走，她与 Jade、Flint 失去联系
facts.anchor: The line is ripped from my hands.
